personal.name: Saksham Tyagi
personal.headline: I build software that solves real business problems.
personal.subtext: I focus on fast, reliable web applications and AI tools that save time and make work easier.

story.problem: We launched a premium artisanal coffee brand and needed a digital storefront that felt as high-quality as our product, while flawlessly handling traffic and orders.
story.approach: As the technical co-founder, I built the entire online infrastructure from scratch. I focused on a lightning-fast checkout experience and automated our backend order processing.
story.solution: A beautiful, high-performing storefront that runs completely on autopilot, handling all the technical heavy-lifting so the team can focus entirely on business growth.

story.problem: A bespoke artisanal gifting brand catering to elite corporate clients (like Lamborghini and Facebook) needed a digital presence that matched the physical luxury of their products, rather than relying on a rigid, generic e-commerce template.
story.approach: I completely re-architected the frontend into a bespoke digital showroom. Utilizing a 'quiet luxury' design system, I implemented asymmetrical editorial layouts, sophisticated typography, and silky, physics-based micro-interactions.
story.solution: A breathtaking, magazine-like digital storefront that elevates the brand identity, featuring an immersive shopping flow for retail customers and a high-fashion portfolio gallery for B2B corporate pitching.

story.problem: A premium thrift brand needed a store that could handle massive spikes in traffic during limited-time sales without crashing or overselling items.
story.approach: I built a custom shopping platform from scratch, focusing on speed, reliable inventory tracking, and a premium user experience.
story.solution: A fast, beautifully designed storefront that successfully handled launch-day traffic without a single crash or checkout error.

endorsements.quote: Having Saksham run the technical infrastructure is a game-changer. The storefront just works, even during traffic spikes, and looks incredibly premium.
endorsements.author: Lakshay

endorsements.quote: From our first meeting to the final launch, collaborating with Saksham was a great experience. The end result is a premium site that perfectly captures our brand identity.
endorsements.author: Sneha
